classification: Observed host-specific legacy elevated sandbox refresh failure caused by a file-sharing conflict on an existing native runtime ACL target. narrow_recovery_investigation.question: Would disabling an unused inherited Node REPL MCP provider remove the failing ACL target without changing permissions?
narrow_recovery_investigation.result: Not established. Pinned setup source independently gathers platform/profile read roots. Support for disabling an MCP provider does not establish that this runtime target disappears from sandbox refresh.

permitted_recovery: Continue through existing role- and task-scoped VeryThinker MCP operations, preserving the native refusal and actual evidence. This does not establish generic native shell or file-edit compatibility on this host.
limitations: The exact process holding the target executable was not terminated or changed.
